notes.title: Patch 0.3
notes.content:
- Changes to the save system. (Sadly old saves won't work in the new system and you have to start a new game)
- Fixed a bug causing big fps drops in certain areas
- Fixed Advanced Workbench
- Fixed black screen when going back to main menu

notes.title: Patch 0.2
notes.content: - Fixed some memory leaks causing crash's

notes.title: Patch 0.1
notes.content:
- Fixed respawning in the place were killed if a respawn point is not set 
- Fixed Zombie hitboxs
- Fixed Gun damage not increasing if shot in the head
- Added critical chance when shooting enemies
- Reduced Bandit and Zombies health
- Fixed Bandits not giving any loot

I am now working on a loot balance update. If you have any suggestions on the loot balance, post it on the forums
